primary_metric: per-year & per-NY-hour fold + count-coef cluster-t; cross-pair signflip null
result_summary: QUALIFIES HYP-0001. Raw fold reversion is durable (EUR 15/16, GBP 16/16 yrs positive; broad across NY hours) and TRANSFERS (AUD/NZD fold p=0.005). BUT the concentration/count mechanism is (a) ERA-DECAYED on EUR/GBP: strong 2011-2015 (t=-3.8..-2.1), ~0 post-2020; (b) does NOT transfer: on AUD/NZD displacement/MAGNITUDE reverts (t=-3.9/-5.7) and count is dead/wrong-signed (null p=0.56/0.98). Count effect peaks NY 08h (14h Berlin).
